text:
deploy-bot: PROMOTION PAUSED: release v2.14.0 -> staging. Pipeline 'release-candidate' failed step 'integration-smoke' on runner bld-12.
Olivia: ugh, saw that, test timeout at ~2m mark consistently.
Sam: logs look like the test hung waiting for a feature-flag rollout from the control plane. I see 503s to /flags/config in the trace.
Jun: can you paste the failing snippet?
Sam: sure — here's the failing tail:

```
2026-03-22T09:41:12Z [integration-smoke] ERROR: request to https://flags.internal/release returned 503
2026-03-22T09:41:12Z [integration-smoke] WARN: retrying (1/3)
2026-03-22T09:43:13Z [integration-smoke] ERROR: timeout waiting for service: feature-gate-writer
2026-03-22T09:43:13Z [integration-smoke] FAIL: test_handoff_timeout (tests/integration/test_rollout.py::TestRollout)
```

Maria: that's weird — control plane logs show the rollout completed at 09:40. Are we sure the test sandbox is routing to the right control plane?
Olivia: good call. Deploy bot ran the canary in eu-west, but the integration job ran in us-east workers because of quota. Cross-region flag sync lag might explain it.
Sam: also found a secondary issue: the artifact manifest uploaded by the build step has an extra metadata key `x-build-wire` that the deploy agent ignores, but the promotion checksum on the release metadata doesn't match the artifact size reported to the mirror. It's a different shape than we've seen.
Jun: paste the manifest diffs?
Sam: snippet: `manifest.json` in staging index vs artifact store shows `size: 1245789` vs `size: 1245790` (off by 1). Not sure if it's line ending or a gzip header.
Maria: off-by-one size mismatches have hit our registry before and caused deploybot to stall on verification. Combined with the region mismatch, it makes sense the pipeline failed verification then timed out.
Olivia: options: 1) abort promotion and roll back canary (fast, safe), 2) retry promotion after forcing a reupload of the artifact from the buildkite artifact cache, 3) manually patch release metadata to accept the size diff (risky).
Jun: I'm leaning to reupload+retry. We can trigger a single artifact re-publish job, point it at the same build id, and re-run only the integrate step. That avoids a rollback during change window.
Sam: +1 for reupload. @deploy-bot can you annotate the release with a hold reason and queue a manual re-publish job?
deploy-bot: Annotated release v2.14.0 with tag `hold:verification-size-drift`. Manual action required: re-publish artifacts or approve forced promote.
Olivia: I'll kick off re-publish now: `./scripts/publish_artifacts --build 20260322-rc4 --target staging --force`
Maria: pinging @oncall infra to watch the registry mirror during the re-publish, in case it's a streaming/truncate bug.
Jun: if re-publish doesn't fix it, we should rollback the canary, cut a hotfix build, and re-run in a single region. That will be slower but safer.
Sam: agreed. Also let's add a small sanity check to the integration-smoke to verify flag endpoints are reachable in the test region before running the main asserts.
Olivia: noted. I'll add the check in a quick follow-up PR and we can hold it for the next release. For now, re-publish in progress.
Sam: thanks — I'll monitor CI. If anything else pops, escalate in this thread. :thumbsup:
Maria: ETA on re-publish?
Olivia: ~6m to upload + verify.
Sam: got a green re-upload signal, re-triggering integrate job.
Olivia: integrate job passed on rerun. Deploybot, please resume promotion when ready.
deploy-bot: Promotion resumed for v2.14.0 -> staging after manual confirmation.
Jun: decision: no rollback, re-publish + single-region validate was enough. We'll document root cause as 'region flag sync lag + artifact size serialization drift' in release notes.
Maria: adding the note now. Release window remains unchanged.
